question: what happened to lizzie on the walking dead
answer: In the Walking Dead, Lizzie and Mika Samuels appear in the fourth season. In the episode "Infected," their father is bitten by walkers and asks Carol to look after their daughters. Lizzie expresses intentions to stab her father's corpse to prevent him from reanimating, but she is unable to carry through. Later, in the episode "Isolation," Carol tells Lizzie she is weak and needs to toughen up. Lizzie also rescues Glenn from a walker in the episode "Internment" and participates in the battle against the Governor in "Too Far Gone."

In the episode `` Infected '' , their father is bitten when walkers get loose in the prison , and before dying he asks Carol to look after his daughters . After being treated with medicine , she plays with Glenn 's blood . In the mid-season finale episode `` Too Far Gone '' , when the Governor attacks the prison , Lizzie convinces the other children to help in the battle . She and Mika carry Rick 's baby daughter Judith and rescue Tyreese from two of the Governor 's soldiers -- shooting Tara 's girlfriend Alisha in the head .
